falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 80% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding that structural support, and losing it proves the pattern failed rather than completed

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility/gradual capitulation; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and true blowoff capitulation, not the measured bottoming process the pattern suggests

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% and holds there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-safety bid this extreme contradicts the macro bottom thesis; it signals recession panic rather than soft-landing stabilization, invalidating the signal to hold risk assets

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
